title: A declared name is one edit away from `phpmailer/phpmailer`
description: composer.json declares a declared package name in composer.json within one edit of `phpmailer/phpmailer`. Composer resolves these names against the configured repositories, so a name that only looks like the intended package installs foreign code. The name this rule expects is `phpmailer/phpmailer`.
remediation: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `phpmailer/phpmailer`, correct it to that exact spelling.
limitation: It compares declared names with `phpmailer/phpmailer` by Levenshtein distance of one and reports a name that is not `phpmailer/phpmailer` itself; it cannot tell whether the similarly spelled package exists, who publishes it, whether it is malicious, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
